import_rule: At validation/runtime composition, imported fixtureId/scenario/expected triples are preserved exactly from verified F009/F010/F016 matrices; PPIA-10 does not rewrite inherited expectations.

local_cases.title: Directional relationship source boundary

local_cases.title: Five Bond examples remain profile examples
local_cases.expected: Five names retain provenance; source XP examples are not universal thresholds.

local_cases.title: Area/community and interpersonal status stay scoped
local_cases.expected: Each status binds explicit scope and owning Condition/status; neither becomes relationship or standing.

local_cases.title: Artisan/craftsman/performer examples remain examples

local_cases.title: Sacred Order capability does not grant authority
local_cases.expected: Capability/progression creates no membership, rank, office, equipment, ownership or permission.

local_cases.title: Warden source-reference-only tree remains a gap
local_cases.expected: Unpublished member-tree content is not fabricated or promoted to authority.

local_cases.title: Standing requires attributable information path
local_cases.expected: Standing mutation is denied without both source Event and plausible information path.

local_cases.title: Influence remains separate from standing
local_cases.expected: Influence can change/spend under its own profile without rewriting standing.

local_cases.title: Membership rank office service and permission stay separate
local_cases.expected: Membership/rank/office/service records revalidate independently; office does not grant unrelated permission.

local_cases.title: Persuasion cannot cross NPC boundary
local_cases.expected: Best plausible authorized outcome is bounded by NPC authority/values; no mind control.

local_cases.title: Deception changes belief not truth
local_cases.expected: NPC belief may change; objective truth remains separately owned and immutable.

local_cases.title: Temporary state does not become relationship
local_cases.expected: Mood/intent/stance may expire without silently changing persistent relationship or standing.

local_cases.title: Atomic Social Mode consequences and compensation
local_cases.expected: All owning-domain Events commit or none; reversible correction uses compensating Events without history deletion.

local_cases.title: Hidden derivatives do not leak
local_cases.expected: Hidden existence/fields are filtered before topology, counts, search, export, diagnostics or AI context.

local_cases.title: Revocation purges two-device protected projections
local_cases.expected: Revocation purges protected cache/realtime/AI-context projections while retaining role-safe audit history.

local_cases.title: Lost response recovers before retry with semantic nonvisual parity
local_cases.expected: Operation status/current version are checked before retry; semantic linear view preserves authorized meaning/actions.

local_cases.title: AI proposal remains nonauthoritative until acceptance
local_cases.expected: Generation changes nothing; explicit authorized acceptance routes only the accepted diff into normal governed mutation.
